channel.title: Mark Thebault
channel.description: Mark Thebault is a principal architect working at the intersection of Agentic AI and platform engineering. Essays, field notes, and project work on building production-grade AI on solid platform foundations.

item.title: How I Would Use GPT-5.6 Without Wasting Intelligence
item.description: My practical model-routing workflow: Sol for the main work, Fable 5 to challenge important plans, Interplan for human review, and Luna for focused sub-agents.

item.title: Tabucom: HTML Plans for AI Agents
item.description: A small open source tool for publishing Markdown, HTML, and static front-ends from AI agent workflows.

item.title: From Vibe Coding to Agentic Engineering
item.description: A shorter note on treating AI agents less like magic autocomplete and more like fast new employees who need context, boundaries, and review.

item.title: Apache Spark, the new way!
item.description: A practical look at running Apache Spark on Kubernetes, from cluster setup to submitting a Pi job.

item.title: Running Docker Swarm in AWS
item.description: How to bootstrap a production-ready Docker Swarm cluster on AWS with Terraform, Ansible, a bastion host, and a default load balancer.

item.title: GDPR Compliant? Let's check!
item.description: A Spark and Jupyter walkthrough for scanning datasets for personally identifiable information before GDPR trouble starts.

item.title: Build a Kubernetes cluster with Kops
item.description: A small Terraform module for preparing the AWS resources needed to build a Kubernetes cluster with kops.

item.title: Get connected! Transit VPC on AWS
item.description: A lightweight Transit VPC setup on AWS using VyOS to connect multiple VPCs through VPN tunnels.
